title: Release gbfs 1.3.10
description:

title: with_mock() is going away
description: This is a heads up to let you know that `with_mock()` is deprecated and will be made defunct soon. The API functions that made it work are being removed in R 4.5.0, so we'd suggest that you switch to `with_mocked_bindings()` instead.

title: change in gbfs org
description:
The main gbfs repo now lives at https://github.com/MobilityData/gbfs rather than under NABSA. URLs seem to forward just fine, though we likely ought to update them before the next release:

https://github.com/simonpcouch/gbfs/blob/0a772223c267935592b3d46692d67954b914f49c/R/get_gbfs.R#L26-L28

title: Error loading some GBFS links
description:
Hi,
On many French cities (for example Marseille, Lyon...), I get an error when trying to load the `get_station_status()` : 

> "The supplied "city" argument looks like the top-level "gbfs.json" URL, but the webpage for the station_status .json feed doesn't seem to exist. Please supply the actual URL or the name of the city as a string."

I think this is due to the layout of the data in some APIs. Is there a resolution?
Thanks for your help!

title: New URLs for Baltimore micromobility
description:
In `get_gbfs_cities()`, a search for `"Baltimore"` returns 4 `System ID`s of `Link_Baltimore`, `lime_baltimore`, `Link_Alexandria`, and `spin baltimore` with outdated URLs -- these should be (as far as I can tell) updated to:

`bird_baltimore` = https://mds.bird.co/gbfs/v2/public/baltimore/gbfs.json
`link_baltimore` = https://mds.linkyour.city/gbfs/us_md_baltimore/gbfs.json
`spin_baltimore` = https://gbfs.spin.pm/api/gbfs/v2_3/baltimore/gbfs.json

This reflects Baltimore's non-renewal of the contract with Lime, and the new contract with Bird.

title: Feedback
description:
**Package**
- You may want to ignore `README.Rmd` in your root directory (`cran-comments.md` too) to keep things tidy.
- It'd really drive home the nature of this data if you're able to first pull it into R but then do a quick computation (number of free bikes?), or a quick visualization (not sure what'd be interesting here). That could live both in the REAMDE and the vignette.

**Poster**
- Once this is printed out 3 ft by 4 ft, it will look a bit spare, so most of our recs are to add in content.
- You could add Reed/class affiliation and logo (search Reed public affairs).
- Your example flowchart is a bit tough to understand. I'm to read it clockwise from the lowerleft? Maybe try it linear? Consider adding visualization (plot) to end of example.
- Could you say more about the 7 static feeds and 2 dynamic feeds, i.e. what exactly is in this data?
- The Purpose should probably be before The Data.
- The features panel is duplicating lots of info - some of these can be removed or moved to either The Data or Purpose.
- Maybe a dedicated panel describing streaming vs archiving (with diagram)?
- Add links to github and netlify.
